summary.name: Sequel Ace
summary.one_liner: Sequel Ace is a macOS app for managing MySQL and MariaDB databases.
use_cases: Browse and query a MySQL database on a Mac
Connect to a database via a mysql:// URL
Move saved connections over from Sequel Pro
Install a database client via Homebrew or the Mac App Store
summary.what_it_does: Sequel Ace is a database management application for macOS that connects to MySQL and MariaDB servers. The page describes connecting via a standard mysql:// URL and importing saved connections from Sequel Pro. It supports making queries and has a keyboard shortcuts reference. It is available on the Mac App Store, through the mas CLI, and as an unofficial Homebrew cask. The project's documentation is maintained on GitHub.
notable: Imports saved connections from Sequel Pro
Available on Mac App Store, mas CLI, and Homebrew
Supports Intel and Apple Silicon Macs
caveats: Requires macOS 13.5 (Ventura) or later; older macOS needs an earlier release listed in the readme
Homebrew cask is unofficial and community maintained
